abilities.title_zh: 大脑增益——所有科技机器人
abilities.desc_zh: {{var_21}}~{{var_22}} 增加对拆除机器人的攻击评级。仅当团队中的所有机器人都具有此协同羁绊时，冲击波才能受益于此奖励。
abilities.desc_en: Brain Gain – All Tech Bots - {{var_21}}~{{var_22}} increase to Attack Rating against Demolition Bots. Shockwave only benefits from this bonus if all Bots on the team have this Synergy.

abilities.desc_zh: Shockwave 的冲击持续 {{var_23}}~{{var_24}} 的时间更长。
abilities.desc_en: Brain Drain – Soundwave - Shockwave's Shocks last {{var_23}}~{{var_24}} longer.

abilities.desc_en: Brain Drain – Ratchet  - Shockwave's Energy Charges last {{var_25}}~{{var_26}} longer.

abilities.desc_zh: 冲击波的冲击会造成 {{var_27}}~{{var_28}} 更多伤害。
abilities.desc_en: Brain Drain – Rhinox -  Shockwave's Shocks deal {{var_27}}~{{var_28}} more damage.

abilities.desc_zh: 冲击波会从震惊的对手身上消耗更多 {{var_29}}~{{var_30}} 的能量。
abilities.desc_en: Brain Drain – Mirage  - Shockwave drains {{var_29}}~{{var_30}} more Power from Shocked opponents.

abilities.desc_zh: 冲击波在战斗开始时和每次 {{var_32}} 时产生 {{var_31}}~3 能量球。
abilities.desc_en: Brain Drain – Blaster - Shockwave generates {{var_31}}~3 Energy Charges at the start of the fight and every {{var_32}}.

abilities.desc_zh: 当同时造成 3 个或更多触电时，冲击波有 {{var_33}}~{{var_34}} 几率对 {{var_35}} 造成眩晕。
abilities.desc_en: Brain Drain – Wheeljack - Shockwave has a {{var_33}}~{{var_34}} chance to inflict Stun for {{var_35}} when inflicting 3 or more Shocks simultaneously.

abilities.desc_zh: 每当他获得 6 个或更多能量球时，冲击波就会比 {{var_38}} 修复 {{var_36}}~{{var_37}} 生命值。
abilities.desc_en: Brain Drain – Jetfire - Shockwave Repairs {{var_36}}~{{var_37}} Health over {{var_38}} each time he gains 6 or more Energy Charges.

abilities.desc_zh: {{var_39}}~{{var_40}} 在战斗开始时为 {{var_41}} 进行远程回避。
abilities.desc_en: Brain Drain – Skywarp - {{var_39}}~{{var_40}} Ranged Evade for {{var_41}} at the start of combat.

abilities.desc_zh: +{{var_42}}~{{var_43}} 对重攻击和特攻 3 造成的伤害。
abilities.desc_en: +{{var_42}}~{{var_43}} damage to Heavy Attacks and Special Attack 3.

abilities.desc_zh: 威震天获得新能力，他的副官获得 {{var_44}}~{{var_45}} 装甲值和攻击评级。
abilities.desc_en: Megatron gains new abilities and his lieutenants gain {{var_44}}~{{var_45}} Armor and Attack Rating.

abilities.desc_zh: 威震天中型连击的最后一击有 {{var_46}}~{{var_47}} 几率造成功率减益，使对手的功率降低 {{var_48}} 至 {{var_49}}。该减益效果可能会融合到对手身上。
abilities.desc_en: The last hit of Megatron’s Medium Combo has a {{var_46}}~{{var_47}} chance to inflict a Power Rate Debuff, reducing the opponent’s Power Rate by {{var_48}} for {{var_49}}. This debuff may be Fused to the opponent.

abilities.desc_zh: 通过+{{var_50}} 增加功率增益。
abilities.desc_en: Intriguing Subject – Nemesis Prime - Increase Power Gain by +{{var_50}}.
